summary: Pin the fixed Expat library in backend, frontend and managed-shard bootstrap runtime images.
userImpact: New runtime images include Expat 2.10.0-r0 to address CVE-2026-113351 and CVE-2026-115506.

instructions: Deploy the qualified replacement images through the normal migration, tenant-isolation and routing gates. Existing image digests remain immutable.

configuration: No application configuration or credential changes are required.

notes: This OS-library correction adds no schema, ledger, grant or application-data changes. Other changes already present in a deployed release retain their own rollback requirements.

security: Install and verify the exact libexpat1=2.10.0-r0 package using the existing signed APK repositories. Preserve scanner, severity and ignore policies.
documentation: Release notes identify the corrected library and affected runtime images.
knownLimitations: Both native architectures and exact published images still require protected candidate qualification before installation.
rollback: Use a previously qualified image only while its current security and database compatibility checks remain valid. An affected old image is not an acceptable security rollback.
validation: All three production Dockerfiles built successfully for native linux/arm64. Each final runtime contains the exact Expat 2.10.0-r0 package and retains UID 65532.

The exact locally built backend, frontend and managed-shard bootstrap images passed the pinned Trivy scanner with zero unignored findings across UNKNOWN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL, using the applicable November 3 vulnerability database and unchanged ignore policy.

Affected dependency-security and bootstrap contracts passed 27 tests; CI contracts passed 218 tests and change detection passed 120 tests. Frozen offline installation, release-note preflight and package-version discipline passed locally.
Local image checks do not replace native AMD64, five-database, browser and exact protected candidate qualification. Publication and deployment remain separate gates.

customerDocumentation.reason: Runtime OS library correction only; existing deployment instructions and public application behavior are unchanged.
